title: Affine subspace PCPP existence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $V$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Either $n=0$ and every Boolean word of length $n$, viewed as a vector over $\mathbb F_2$, belongs to the affine subspace $a+V$, or $n$ is positive and there exists a PCPP description for the property that a Boolean word, viewed as a vector over $\mathbb F_2$, belongs to $a+V$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
